the cat sat on the warm sunny windowsill every morning before breakfast
the cat slept under the big oak tree
the dog ran across the wide green field this afternoon while the sun set
the dog ran across the street
the dog barked at the mail carrier every single day
a bird sang from the tallest branch at dawn
a bird sang from the old rooftop
a bird flew over the quiet lake without making a sound
we walked home slowly after the long day
we walked home in the rain
